title: द्विसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 72 · Protecting the people without sin

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks how a king can protect his people without being touched by sin, and Bhishma says that he must honour the learned, give gifts and show mercy. He should reward the helpers and perform sacrifices, and so gain the world of Indra.
summary.kn: ರಾಜ ಪಾಪ ಸ್ಪರ್ಶವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಪ್ರಜೆ ಹೇಗೆ ರಕ್ಷಿಸುವನೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ವಿದ್ವಾಂಸರನ್ನು ಗೌರವಿಸಿ, ದಾನ ನೀಡಿ, ಕರುಣೆ ತೋರಬೇಕೆಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸಹಾಯಕರಿಗೆ ಬಹುಮಾನ ನೀಡಿ ಯಜ್ಞ ಮಾಡಿ ಇಂದ್ರಲೋಕ ಪಡೆಯಬೇಕು.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि राजा पाप से छुए बिना प्रजा की रक्षा कैसे करे, और भीष्म कहते हैं कि वह विद्वानों का सम्मान, दान और दया करे। सहायकों को पुरस्कृत कर यज्ञ करे और इस प्रकार इन्द्रलोक पाए।
summary.te: రాజు పాపం అంటకుండా ప్రజలను ఎలా రక్షించాలని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు; విద్వాంసులను గౌరవించి, దానాలు చేసి, దయ చూపాలని భీష్ముడు అంటాడు. సహాయకులకు బహుమతులు ఇచ్చి యజ్ఞాలు చేసి ఇంద్రలోకం పొందాలి.
summary.ta: பாவம் தீண்டாமல் மன்னன் குடிகளை எப்படிக் காப்பது என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, கற்றோரை மதித்து, தானம் செய்து, இரக்கம் காட்ட வேண்டும் என்று பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார். உதவியோருக்குப் பரிசளித்து வேள்வி செய்து இந்திர உலகை அடையலாம்.
summary.ml: പാപം തൊടാതെ രാജാവ് എങ്ങനെ ജനങ്ങളെ സംരക്ഷിക്കുമെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു; പണ്ഡിതന്മാരെ ആദരിക്കുകയും ദാനം ചെയ്യുകയും കരുണ കാണിക്കുകയും വേണമെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു. സഹായിച്ചവർക്ക് പ്രതിഫലം നൽകണമെന്നും യജ്ഞങ്ങൾ ചെയ്യണമെന്നും, അങ്ങനെ ഇന്ദ്രലോകം നേടണമെന്നും അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.72; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
कथं राजा प्रजा रक्षन्नाधिबन्धेन युज्यते ।
धर्मे च नापराध्नोति तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥

meaning.en: Tell me, grandfather, how a king who protects his people avoids being bound by blame and does not offend against righteousness.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
समासेनैव ते तात धर्मान्वक्ष्यामि निश्चितान् ।
विस्तरेण हि धर्माणां न जात्वन्तमवाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: I shall tell you the settled duties in brief, dear child, for in full detail one could never reach the end of them.

verses.text:
धर्मनिष्ठाञ्श्रुतवतो वेदव्रतसमाहितान् ।
अर्चितान्वासयेथास्त्वं गृहे गुणवतो द्विजान् ॥

meaning.en: Honour and settle in your house learned Brahmanas who are firm in righteousness and devoted to the Vedic vows, and who are virtuous.

verses.text:
प्रत्युत्थायोपसंगृह्य चरणावभिवाद्य च ।
अथ सर्वाणि कुर्वीथाः कार्याणि सपुरोहितः ॥

meaning.en: Rise to greet them, take hold of their feet and salute them; only then, together with your household priest, should you do all your affairs.

verses.text:
धर्मकार्याणि निर्वर्त्य मङ्गलानि प्रयुज्य च ।
ब्राह्मणान्वाचयेथास्त्वमर्थसिद्धिजयाशिषः ॥

meaning.en: Having finished your religious duties and performed auspicious rites, have Brahmanas recite blessings for success in your purposes and victory.

verses.text:
आर्जवेन च संपन्नो धृत्या बुद्ध्या च भारत ।
अर्थार्थं परिगृह्णीयात्कामक्रोधौ च वर्जयेत् ॥

meaning.en: Descendant of Bharata, be upright, steady and wise; gather wealth for the sake of the kingdom's needs, and keep off desire and anger.

verses.text:
कामक्रोधौ पुरस्कृत्य योऽर्थं राजानुतिष्ठति ।
न स धर्मं न चाप्यर्थं परिगृह्णाति बालिशः ॥

meaning.en: The king who pursues wealth with desire and anger in front wins neither righteousness nor wealth; he is a fool.

verses.text:
मा स्म लुब्धांश्च मूर्खांश्च कामे चार्थेषु यूयुजः ।
अलुब्धान्बुद्धिसंपन्नान्सर्वकर्मसु योजयेत् ॥

meaning.en: Never set greedy people or fools to the tasks of desire and wealth; set men free of greed and endowed with wisdom to all works.

verses.text:
मूर्खो ह्यधिकृतोऽर्थेषु कार्याणामविशारदः ।
प्रजाः क्लिश्नात्ययोगेन कामद्वेषसमन्वितः ॥

meaning.en: A fool put in charge of the revenue, unskilled in his duties, full of likes and dislikes, troubles the people by misuse.

verses.text:
बलिषष्ठेन शुल्केन दण्डेनाथापराधिनाम् ।
शास्त्रनीतेन लिप्सेथा वेतनेन धनागमम् ॥

meaning.en: Seek income as the Shastras prescribe: a sixth part as tribute, tolls, fines on offenders, and by paying wages.

verses.text:
दापयित्वा करं धर्म्यं राष्ट्रं नित्यं यथाविधि ।
अशेषान्कल्पयेद्राजा योगक्षेमानतन्द्रितः ॥

meaning.en: Having had the lawful tax duly paid by the kingdom always, the king should without laziness provide for all the people's gaining and keeping of goods.

verses.text:
गोपायितारं दातारं धर्मनित्यमतन्द्रितम् ।
अकामद्वेषसंयुक्तमनुरज्यन्ति मानवाः ॥

meaning.en: People love a king who protects, who gives, who is always devoted to righteousness without sloth, and who is free of desire and hatred.

verses.text:
मा स्माधर्मेण लाभेन लिप्सेथास्त्वं धनागमम् ।
धर्मार्थावध्रुवौ तस्य योऽपशास्त्रपरो भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: Do not seek an income by unrighteous gain; for one who relies on bad teaching, righteousness and wealth are both unstable.

verses.text:
अपशास्त्रपरो राजा संचयान्नाधिगच्छति ।
अस्थाने चास्य तद्वित्तं सर्वमेव विनश्यति ॥

meaning.en: A king devoted to bad teaching does not accumulate anything, and all his wealth is lost in the wrong places.

verses.text:
अर्थमूलोऽपहिंसां च कुरुते स्वयमात्मनः ।
करैरशास्त्रदृष्टैर्हि मोहात्संपीडयन्प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: Out of delusion, pressing the people with levies not seen in the Shastras, a king whose root is wealth does injury to himself.

verses.text:
ऊधश्छिन्द्याद्धि यो धेन्वाः क्षीरार्थी न लभेत्पयः ।
एवं राष्ट्रमयोगेन पीडितं न विवर्धते ॥

meaning.en: One who wants milk and cuts off the udder of the cow gets no milk; so a kingdom pressed wrongly does not grow.

verses.text:
यो हि दोग्ध्रीमुपास्ते तु स नित्यं लभते पयः ।
एवं राष्ट्रमुपायेन भुञ्जानो लभते फलम् ॥

meaning.en: The one who tends the milch cow always gets milk; so one who enjoys the kingdom by proper means gets its fruit.

verses.text:
अथ राष्ट्रमुपायेन भुज्यमानं सुरक्षितम् ।
जनयत्यतुलां नित्यं कोशवृद्धिं युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira, a well-guarded kingdom enjoyed by proper means always produces a matchless increase of the treasury.

verses.text:
दोग्धि धान्यं हिरण्यं च प्रजा राज्ञि सुरक्षिता ।
नित्यं स्वेभ्यः परेभ्यश्च तृप्ता माता यथा पयः ॥

meaning.en: The people, well protected by the king, yield grain and gold, always satisfied, like a mother giving milk to her own and to others.

verses.text:
मालाकारोपमो राजन्भव माङ्गारिकोपमः ।
तथा युक्तश्चिरं राष्ट्रं भोक्तुं शक्यसि पालयन् ॥

meaning.en: Be like a garland-maker, king, and not like a charcoal-burner; so engaged you can long enjoy the kingdom by protecting it.

verses.text:
परचक्राभियानेन यदि ते स्याद्धनक्षयः ।
अथ साम्नैव लिप्सेथा धनमब्राह्मणेषु यत् ॥

meaning.en: If your wealth falls away through an attack by a foreign army, then try by conciliation alone to gather the wealth that is not in Brahmana hands.

verses.text:
मा स्म ते ब्राह्मणं दृष्ट्वा धनस्थं प्रचलेन्मनः ।
अन्त्यायामप्यवस्थायां किमु स्फीतस्य भारत ॥

meaning.en: Never let your mind waver on seeing a Brahmana with wealth, even in the last extremity, let alone in prosperity, Bharata.

verses.text:
धनानि तेभ्यो दद्यास्त्वं यथाशक्ति यथार्हतः ।
सान्त्वयन्परिरक्षंश्च स्वर्गमाप्स्यसि दुर्जयम् ॥

meaning.en: Give them wealth according to your ability and to their merit; by soothing and protecting them you will gain heaven, so hard to win.

verses.text:
एवं धर्मेण वृत्तेन प्रजास्त्वं परिपालयन् ।
स्वन्तं पुण्यं यशोवन्तं प्राप्स्यसे कुरुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: Thus guarding the people by righteous conduct you will gain merit, fame and a good end, joy of the Kurus.

verses.text:
धर्मेण व्यवहारेण प्रजाः पालय पाण्डव ।
युधिष्ठिर तथा युक्तो नाधिबन्धेन योक्ष्यसे ॥

meaning.en: Pandava, protect the people with righteous dealing; so engaged, Yudhishthira, you will not be bound by blame.

verses.text:
एष एव परो धर्मो यद्राजा रक्षते प्रजाः ।
भूतानां हि यथा धर्मे रक्षणं च परा दया ॥

meaning.en: This is the highest duty, that a king protects the people; and protection of creatures, together with supreme compassion, is righteousness.

verses.text:
तस्मादेवं परं धर्मं मन्यन्ते धर्मकोविदाः ।
यद्राजा रक्षणे युक्तो भूतेषु कुरुते दयाम् ॥

meaning.en: Therefore those who know righteousness hold this to be the highest duty, that the king, engaged in protection, shows compassion to beings.

verses.text:
यदह्ना कुरुते पापमरक्षन्भयतः प्रजाः ।
राजा वर्षसहस्रेण तस्यान्तमधिगच्छति ॥

meaning.en: The sin a king commits in a day by failing to protect the people out of fear, he reaches the end of only after a thousand years.

verses.text:
यदह्ना कुरुते पुण्यं प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन् ।
दश वर्षसहस्राणि तस्य भुङ्क्ते फलं दिवि ॥

meaning.en: The merit a king earns in a day by guarding the people righteously, he enjoys the fruit of in heaven for ten thousand years.

verses.text:
स्विष्टिः स्वधीतिः सुतपा लोकाञ्जयति यावतः ।
क्षणेन तानवाप्नोति प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन् ॥

meaning.en: As many worlds as one wins by good sacrifice, good study and fine austerity, he wins in a moment by guarding the people righteously.

verses.text:
एवं धर्मं प्रयत्नेन कौन्तेय परिपालयन् ।
इह पुण्यफलं लब्ध्वा नाधिबन्धेन योक्ष्यसे ॥

meaning.en: Son of Kunti, thus guarding righteousness with effort, you will win the fruit of merit here and not be bound by blame.

verses.text:
स्वर्गलोके च महतीं श्रियं प्राप्स्यसि पाण्डव ।
असंभवश्च धर्माणामीदृशानामराजसु ।
तस्माद्राजैव नान्योऽस्ति यो महत्फलमाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: Pandava, you will gain great glory in heaven. Such duties cannot arise without kings; therefore there is no one but a king who can win so great a fruit.

verses.text:
स राज्यमृद्धिमत्प्राप्य धर्मेण परिपालयन् ।
इन्द्रं तर्पय सोमेन कामैश्च सुहृदो जनान् ॥

meaning.en: Having obtained a prosperous kingdom and guarding it righteously, please Indra with soma and please your friends and people with their wishes.
